definitions.flow: One NFStream record in flows_rf21.csv. ID = {session_id}_{flow_index}
definitions.alert: One event_type=alert line in eve.json after filtering. ID = {session_id}_{alert_seq}
definitions.event: One session = one event (n=15). ID = session_id. GT: 0=normal, 1=attack

matching.ip_port_match: not required (single attacker-target pair per session)

suricata_primary.source: Original E1 EVE artifacts (Suricata 8.0.4 frozen environment)
suricata_primary.result: 0 non-excluded alerts on all 15 Test sessions

suricata_supplementary.source: Offline replay with Suricata 7.0.3, rules SHA 50c008fd, -k none
suricata_supplementary.result: ET behavioral on EXPLOIT×3; stream built-in on DOS×3; 0 on others

rf_source: V3_RF21_seed42 from E2 v2.1 (trained on DEV_TRAIN, threshold on DEV_CAL)

strategies.S2: RF-only: detected = any flow with score >= threshold
strategies.S6: Full evidence-aware routing: detected = S1 OR S2, with routing tier

mcnemar: S1 vs S6, two-sided, alpha=0.05, exploratory n=15
